text: The normal labs and ultrasound have ruled out infection, autoimmune disease, and structural kidney issues. speaker: Patient
text: The sinus symptoms improved, but the flank pain and fever stayed. The rash happened during the antibiotics and then resolved after the change in medication.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms (DRESS) syndrome with secondary muscle strain.
